name: Aoba Saya
source:
Early 30's
Aoba Masayoshi's wife. A woman who is tolerant and enthusiastic, neat and clean.
From the same school as the protagonist, it was admirated by all of the boys.
Became a housewife after married, but feels lonely during the day by being alone in the house.
There is more or less of a sex life but is being pestered by the mother-in-law for a child, causing stress
"U-Understood..... I will hear what Akitsu-kun wants to say"
